paper_title: SimSMoE Solving Representational Collapse via Similarity Measure

model_annotation: The plot illustrates the behavior of two lines representing different validating metrics as a function of training steps. The x-axis is labeled "Training Steps" and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 50, with tick labels at intervals of 10, and the units are given as (x10^3). The y-axis is labeled “BPC” and has a linear scale ranging from 1.2 to 2.2. The first line, labeled "SMoE Validating," is solid black with 'x' markers and begins at a value of approximately 2.17 at the start of the x-axis (0 training steps) and decreases to approximately 1.23 at the end of the x-axis (50 training steps). The second line, labeled “SimSMoE Validating,” is solid magenta with 'o' markers and starts at approximately 2.01 at the start of the x-axis (0 training steps) and declines to approximately 1.24 at the end of the x-axis (50 training steps).
